title: Warm Spicy Saudi Arabian Red Pepper Skewers
description: A sweet and crispy Saudi Arabian dish featuring red pepper, coconut cream, and a blend of spices, perfect for adventurous eaters, this vegan friendly dish is sure to delight.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the red bell peppers into 1 inch pieces and set aside.
In a large bowl, whisk together the coconut cream, olive oil, smoked paprika, cumin, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Add the red bell pepper pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the coconut cream mixture.
Thread the coated red bell pepper pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the skewers from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
Drizzle the skewers with lemon juice and serve warm.
